FT-035.adaptation: Interpreted 'adversarial bounds' as one exact-variant assert_eq! per hostile shape listed in the assignment (deep parens/negation/mix-chain at and past MAX_DEPTH, input at and past the 512-byte cap, percentage 0/100/101/huge-overflow, unterminated paren, empty component list, wrong component count, out-of-range components, lone separator, multi-byte-at-boundary), added in src/parser.rs and src/lib.rs. Interpreted 'exact identity regressions' as a dedicated tests/identity_regressions.rs pinning resolve(...) output to hand-derived literal Color constants, following rev2's discipline of never deriving expectations by calling this crate's own resolver (one dyadic-fraction correction made mid-work after 1.0-0.8 proved not exactly 0.2 in f64). Because 'invalid UTF-8' cannot reach this crate's public &str-only API without unsafe code, substituted the closest constructible adjacent attack (multi-byte characters sitting exactly on length/depth scanning boundaries) and said so explicitly rather than silently skipping the case. Wrote an explicit compatibility statement in coordination/daniel-color.md naming which xcolor behaviours are and are not implemented, since this crate has never been numerically compared against real xcolor/LaTeX output and does not claim to be.
